rows.officialClass: PKD 2007 Sekcja S dział 96 and Sekcja T działy 97-98 (other personal services with households as employers), published as one line
rows.measure: number of entities of the national economy entered in the REGON register (podmioty gospodarki narodowej), by registered seat, as of 31 December
rows.note: Every entity entered in REGON with its seat in the gmina, natural persons running a business included; the register keeps entities that have ceased activity without striking them off, so it counts more than the businesses trading. Hairdressing (96.02) cannot be separated at gmina level.

source.title: Bank Danych Lokalnych: Podmioty wg sekcji i działów PKD 2007 oraz sektorów własnościowych (P2809)

rows.officialClass: PKD 2007 Sekcja I, dział 56: Działalność usługowa związana z wyżywieniem (food and beverage service activities)
rows.measure: number of entities of the national economy entered in the REGON register (podmioty gospodarki narodowej), by registered seat, as of 31 December
rows.note: Every entity entered in REGON with its seat in the gmina, natural persons running a business included; the register keeps entities that have ceased activity without striking them off, so it counts more than the businesses trading. The whole division 56: restaurants, takeaways, catering and bars together; the register is not published finer at gmina level.
